### Executive Summary
A major security breach impacting student data in California has resulted in the unauthorized exposure of records belonging to millions of individuals. 

As reported by ET Education, the compromised dataset contains sensitive information, explicitly including students' disability statuses. The exposure represents a significant data privacy incident affecting educational datasets within the state.
